source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, perfectly flat surface filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Early-modern Pike-and-Shot munition cuirass armour plate forged from brushed high-nickel steel at 28 cm scale, featuring shallow parallel vertical Maximilian fluting ribs spaced 3 cm apart, fine directional emery-polishing grain, and a clean rolled horizontal border with flush-set domed rivet heads. Neutral mid-grey (#8a8a8a), fully desaturated: no brown, tan or warm cast; only the light and dark relief of the weave so it can be tinted to any palette colour.
